lines.text: After Rehoboam became strong, he and all Israel forsook the Law of the LORD, and Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.
Shishak came with 1,200 chariots and 60,000 horsemen, and he captured the fortified cities of Judah.
Nathan the prophet told Rehoboam the LORD had forsaken them, so they humbled themselves and the LORD said He would not destroy them.
Shishak seized the gold shields Solomon had made, so Rehoboam made silver shields and the guards carried them.
Rehoboam reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, was buried in the City of David, and his son Abijah reigned in his place.
